title: UDS: more services supported and refactoring
description:
This patch improves the UDS code in the following ways:
- refactors the parsing of memory address + size
- refactors the parsing of subfunctions
- merges all data record hfs into one
- adds parsing for: CDTCI, RMBA, RSDBI, CC, ARS, RDBPI, DDDI, RU, RFT, WMBA, SDT, and LC
